name: PostHog for Startups
benefit: $50,000 in PostHog credits for 12 months, plus partner perks worth $12,000+. From September 14, 2026 the credits do not cover PostHog AI tools.
eligibility: Less than 2 years old and raised less than $5m. Signed up from January 1, 2023. Account on the company email domain.

name: AWS Activate
benefit: Up to $200,000 in Activate Credits on the Portfolio path through an Activate Provider. Self-funded Founders start with $1,000 and may qualify for up to $5,000. Extra credits for AI startups.
eligibility: Pre-Series B, founded in the last 10 years, AWS account on Paid Tier, new to Activate Credits or requesting more than you already received

name: Google for Startups Cloud Program
benefit: Start tier up to $2,000. Scale tier up to $200,000, or up to $350,000 for AI startups. Workspace Business Plus free for 12 months for new signups. Scale includes up to $12,000 in Enhanced Support credits.
eligibility: Start: founded within 24 months, planning to raise, no prior GCP credits beyond the free trial. Scale: founded within 5 years, Pre-Seed or Seed within 5 years or Series A within 12 months, no more than $5,000 in prior GCP credits

name: Microsoft for Startups
benefit: Up to $150K in startup credits over time as you show product progress, service adoption, and sustained Azure usage. Formerly Founders Hub.
eligibility: Software product the company owns; privately held, for-profit; HQ where Azure is available; no more than $350,000 in lifetime free Azure credits; no Series C or later; not an agency, consultancy, school, or government body; no crypto mining

name: Cloudflare for Startups
benefit: Up to $350k in credits for one year. Tier 3 $10k under $1M raised. Tier 2 $100k under $5M raised with an affiliated partner. Tier 1 $350k at $5M+ raised with an affiliated partner.
eligibility: Founded within the last 10 years, funded up to Series B, one-time per startup

name: Vercel for Startups
benefit: Up to $30,000 in Flexible Commitment Amount, Enterprise-tier access, and startup-focused support
eligibility: Startup teams, reviewed on application

name: Claude for Startups
benefit: $1,000 Claude API credits, a free year of Claude Team with up to five Premium seats if you are new to Team, and up to $45K in offer value from participating partners. Up to $100K more API credits through partner VCs. Credits expire six months after the grant.
eligibility: Founded in the last 5 years or funded in the last 2. Open to bootstrapped, pre-seed, and venture-backed teams. Needs a Claude Console account and a company email that matches the website domain.

name: GitHub for Startups
benefit: $10,000 in GitHub credits across GitHub Enterprise for up to 12 months
eligibility: Affiliated with a GitHub for Startups partner. Outside funding up to Series B. New to GitHub Enterprise, not on Enterprise in the past 6 months. No prior GitHub credits.

name: Notion for Startups
benefit: Up to 6 months free on the Business plan with Notion AI included, save $12,000. 6 months if you are affiliated with a startup partner, 3 months otherwise, and a 1-month trial if you have under 10 employees.
eligibility: Non-paying Notion customer, under 100 employees, valid work email, no previous Notion promotions. Aimed at startups building scalable tech products.

name: Stripe Atlas
benefit: $2,500 in Stripe product credits for your first year after incorporation, access to over $50,000 in partner discounts, and the $500 Atlas fee refunded when you deposit $5,000 into a Stripe Treasury account
eligibility: Founders incorporating a Delaware company through Atlas. $500 one-time setup fee.

name: Affonso for Startups
benefit: 50% off in year one, 25% in year two, and 10% in year three
eligibility: SaaS founded less than 3 years ago, under $25k MRR, under $3M raised. Never on a paid Affonso plan. Apply before signup or within 90 days of a free account.

name: HubSpot for Startups
benefit: 30% to 90% off in year one. Later years discounted, for example 50% off in year two and 25% off in year three. Initial discount period is typically two years.
eligibility: Affiliated with an approved partner, or documented venture funding. Raised Pre-seed, Seed, or Series A, not Series B or later. Net-new Professional or Enterprise products only.

name: Framer for Startups
benefit: Save $360 with a free year of Framer Pro
eligibility: Startup backed by a Framer-approved partner

name: Customer.io Startup Program
benefit: Up to 12 months of free access, including up to 30,000 customer profiles. Email, SMS, and push on the Startup plan, plus a graduation offer afterwards.
eligibility: Raised less than $10 million. Never been a Customer.io customer. Lists collected through normal methods, not purchased. A partner accelerator or VC helps.

name: ActiveCampaign Start Up
benefit: 90% off any annual plan for the first year. Full price after year one.
eligibility: New customers only. Less than 2 years old, current incubator partner or alum within the past 12 months, and no more than $1MM in funding.

name: SendPulse Startup Grant
benefit: $5,000 in credits for marketing, sales, and customer communications over 12 months. Credits do not cover the email verifier or SMS.
eligibility: All four: launched within the past three years, an innovative product, not an eCommerce or online store, and no history of paid SendPulse plans.

name: Coresender for Startups
benefit: 80% off for 12 months, with full-plan features
eligibility: New customer, started in the last 2 years, raised $1M or less

name: Buffer Startup Program
benefit: 50% off any paid plan for the first 12 months. Cannot be combined with other offers.
eligibility: All of: fewer than 50 employees, 2 years or younger from incorporation, Pre-seed through Series A, and new to Buffer with no prior paid plan.

name: SocialBu for Startups
benefit: 6 months of SocialBu free, including tools and workshops
eligibility: New to SocialBu and active on at least one social platform. Fewer than 50 members. Seed or early-stage funding helps.

name: Typeform Startup Program
benefit: Save up to 75% on annual Business plans
eligibility: Less than $5M in funding, fewer than 50 employees, less than 5 years old

name: Apollo for Startups
benefit: 50% off Basic or Professional for 1 year, up to 5 seats, plus full B2B database access and 1:1 support
eligibility: Fewer than 20 employees, no existing Apollo subscription, and a valid company domain. Affiliation with a startup partner helps. Teams without a partner can still apply.

name: Clay Wedge
benefit: A two-week live and async GTM program. Participants earn credits during the cohort.
eligibility: Series A and below, venture-backed. Founders and first GTM hires at pre-seed through Series A.

name: AnnounceKit Startup Program
benefit: 50% off for 12 months, all plan features included. Standard rate afterwards.
eligibility: Fewer than 5 employees including founders, less than 2 years old, raised $1M or less. Bootstrapped teams qualify. Live product or active development.

name: Sanity Startup Program
benefit: One year free on the Growth plan, $9k in value, then Growth at $15 per seat per month
eligibility: Fewer than 20 employees, raised less than $5M. Currently available to portfolio companies of Sanity partners, with a partner coupon code.

name: Intercom Early Stage
benefit: 93% off in year one, 50% off in year two, and 25% off in year three. Helpdesk from $33/month. 300 Fin outcomes and 15 Fin qualifications per month in year one.
eligibility: Fewer than 15 employees, up to $10M in funding

name: Zendesk for Startups
benefit: Zendesk free for up to 2 years, Suite Professional plus Copilot, up to 50 agents. Baseline is 6 months. One to two years only through VC or accelerator partners.
eligibility: New Zendesk subscriber, fewer than 250 employees. Teams of 50 to 249 must be partner-referred. No more than Series B, company under 10 years old, outside funding from Angel to Series B.

name: Featurebase Early-stage startup program
benefit: Professional plan at $63 per month, 86% off the $450 list price, then 40% off year two and 10% off year three. 6 full seats. 50 free Fibi AI resolutions per month in year one.
eligibility: Founded less than 2 years ago, fewer than 6 employees, raised less than $3M, never on a paid Featurebase plan, apply within 90 days of sign-up, max 6 seats

name: Zoho for Startups
benefit: Zoho Wallet credits in two phases, valid 360 days
eligibility: Currently only for startups working with or mentored by Zoho partners. New applicants with no prior Zoho credits.

name: Attio Startup Program
benefit: 80% off the annual Pro plan and credits for the first year, 30% off the second year, plus onboarding support and partner perks including 3 months of Linear and 6 months of Notion free
eligibility: VC-backed, signed up within the last 90 days, incorporated less than 10 years ago. Valid for workspaces of up to 10 seats.

name: Salesforce Launchpad
benefit: Free and discounted Salesforce solutions
eligibility: Venture-backed startups across industries and stages. Application reviewed for proof of funding.

name: Help Scout for Startups
benefit: 6 months free on Help Scout Plus with AI Answers
eligibility: New Help Scout customer, an incorporated tech startup less than two years old, and under $1 million ARR

name: Crisp Startup Program
benefit: A 30% discount on Essentials and Plus that stays attached rather than expiring. Mini is not included.
eligibility: Raised less than $1M, existed less than 3 years

name: Plain for Startups
benefit: 50% off the Horizon plan: $6k flat fee, 12 months, 10 seats
eligibility: VC-backed, up to $5m in funding. Eligibility confirmed on a call.

name: FeatureOS Startup Program
benefit: The full Starter plan free for 6 months
eligibility: Founded less than 2 years ago, fewer than 15 employees, less than $1M raised. Bootstrapped teams and free-plan users can apply.

name: Mixpanel for Startups
benefit: First year free. $145,000 value, 1 billion events and 1 million Session Replays.
eligibility: Incorporated less than five years ago, raised no more than $8M, no other Mixpanel offer redeemed, never on a paid plan

name: Amplitude Startup Plan
benefit: First year of Amplitude 100% free on the Growth plan, up to 100M events/month, $60,000 value. Year two, 40% off.
eligibility: Under 20 employees and under $10M raised. Partners get extra discounts. Separate Tech for Black Founders track: under $30M raised, under 150 employees, US-based.

name: Statsig Startup Program
benefit: All Statsig Enterprise features for 12 months, plus 1B events, over $50,000 in value
eligibility: Received less than $50 million in funding, founded less than 5 years ago

name: Fullstory Startup Plan
benefit: A Startup Plan for early-stage businesses
eligibility: Qualifying early-stage companies

name: DigitalOcean Startups

eligibility: Raised $10m or less, company website and matching email, new to DigitalOcean credits. Prioritizes AI-native startups. Service businesses are not eligible.

name: Render for Startups
benefit: Founder tier $500. Build $2,500 to $5K through a partner. Scale $10K under $1M funding or $25K at $1M+. AI tier $100K.
eligibility: Founder: seed funding of at least $25K, raised less than $50M. Higher tiers through enrolled accelerator or VC partners. AI tier needs at least $2.5M from an enrolled top-tier VC.

name: Fly.io Startup Credits
benefit: Up to $15,000 in credits and a shared Slack channel
eligibility: Seed or Series A, backed by a VC or accelerator, no prior Fly.io startup credits

name: Scaleway Startup Program

name: Civo Startup Program

name: Alibaba Cloud AI Catalyst Program

eligibility: AI startups. Applications are reviewed in a few business days.

name: Netlify for Startups
benefit: Netlify at a discounted rate. Details are shared upon approval.
eligibility: VC-backed portfolio companies of approved venture partners. Access is limited to approved VC, incubator, and accelerator partners.

name: OpenAI for Startups
benefit: Credits and dedicated support through eligible VC partners
eligibility: Must be backed by a VC in OpenAI's partner network. You need a referral code from that VC.

name: NVIDIA Inception
benefit: Free cloud credits from NVIDIA and partners, preferred pricing on hardware and software, plus VC introductions. No fees or equity.
eligibility: At least one developer, a working website, officially incorporated, and less than 10 years old. Any funding stage. Revenue is not required.

name: Pinecone for Startups
benefit: Free Standard Tier and Pro Support, plus usage credits and discounts
eligibility: Series A or earlier, fewer than 100 employees

name: ElevenLabs Startup Grants
benefit: 12 months of free access to the full platform. Over 680 hours of Agents usage, more than $5,500 in value.
eligibility: Startups or companies with fewer than 25 employees. No agencies or consultancies. One application per company.

name: Modal for Startups
benefit: Free GPU credits
eligibility: New to Modal. Seed to Series A: raised any amount from a partner VC or more than $1M from any fund. Series B and later is a custom tier.

name: Together AI Startup Accelerator
benefit: Up to $15K if you raised up to $5M, $30K from $5M to $10M, or $50K over $10M, plus forward-deployed engineering hours
eligibility: Tiered by funding raised

name: Fireworks AI for Startups
benefit: Credits that expire after one year, plus options for higher rate limits
eligibility: Founded within the last 5 years, venture-backed with more than $500k in funding, and not Series D or later

name: Runpod Startup Program
benefit: Starter: $1,000 in credits. Scale: load $50,000 and get $25,000 in bonus credits, $75K total on a 12-month agreement.
eligibility: Starter fits Pre-Series A teams with a working product. Scale is for venture-backed startups from Seed through Series B+ with production workloads.

name: Nebius for Startups
benefit: Introductory credits and compute savings
eligibility: Through VC partners, for startups that have raised $5M+

name: LangSmith for Startups
benefit: Build tier: discounted seat pricing. Scale tier: $10K in credits for 1 year, or 2 years for YC.
eligibility: Build: first-time customer, less than $10M funding, at least $25K in seed funding. Scale: Series A up to $50M or earlier, backed by a LangChain premier VC partner.

name: Langfuse for Startups
benefit: 50% off the entire Langfuse bill for 12 months
eligibility: Up to $5 million in total venture funding, bootstrapped teams included. Incorporated within the last 5 years.

name: Firecrawl startup deal

eligibility: Under $10M raised, fewer than 50 people, founded less than 5 years ago. Existing customers included.

name: OpenRouter Startup Program
benefit: Up to $5,000 in universal inference credits and 0% processing fees for 12 months
eligibility: Pre-Series B. Referred by an approved OpenRouter partner. Professional email on the company domain, less than $500 in lifetime spend, and no previous startup credits.

name: Baseten AI Startup Program
benefit: Up to $25,000 in credits for Dedicated Inference or Training, and up to $2,500 in credits for Model APIs
eligibility: AI is core to the product. Seed to Series A, started less than 5 years ago, and a net-new customer who has never received Baseten credits.

name: Anyscale Startup Program
benefit: Up to $20K in Anyscale credits
eligibility: Open to teams building on Anyscale

name: fal Startup Program
benefit: Start with $1,000 in credits and grow to $5,000 as usage scales, plus partner perks
eligibility: Companies that can show they are building at scale through traction or funding. Real users, revenue, or institutional funding.

name: Deepgram Startup Program
benefit: Up to $100,000 in credits over 12 months for STT, TTS, and Voice Agent
eligibility: An AI builder or early-stage startup, in production or launching in the next 6 months, and committed to building with the community

name: AssemblyAI Startup Program
benefit: 12 months of recurring free credits, then startup pricing
eligibility: Early-stage startups, bootstrapped through Series A, building with voice or audio and launching within the next six months

name: Cartesia Startups Grant
benefit: 12 months free. 96M credits a year: 8M shared Sonic and Ink credits each month, plus $299 per month in Managed Agents credits.
eligibility: Startups at any stage. Students and one-off projects are reviewed case by case.

name: Vapi for Startups
benefit: 90,000 free minutes: 7,500 free minutes per month for 12 months, plus Slack support
eligibility: Pre-seed to Series A with $250k+ in funding, launching to customers within 6 months

name: Telnyx Startups Program

eligibility: A working voice AI agent at the center of the product, $500k+ raised, and a working prototype or a clear path to launch

name: LlamaParse Startup Offer
benefit: $2K in free credits, available for one year, plus bulk-credit discounts in production
eligibility: Less than $50M raised, and at least $250k raised to date

name: E2B for Startups
benefit: One-time $20,000 in E2B credits and the Pro tier
eligibility: Startups under three years old that have raised less than $5M

name: Tavily for Startups
benefit: Up to 100k Tavily API credits for 6 months, plus engineering support and network access
eligibility: Early-stage, VC-backed startups building AI agents or LLMs, typically pre-seed through Series A

name: Mem0 Startup Program
benefit: 3 months of free access to the Pro plan, $1,000 of value
eligibility: New users

name: Linear startup program
benefit: Free access to Linear's Business plan
eligibility: Affiliated with an official Linear partner. Non-paying Linear users with fewer than 50 employees.

name: JetBrains Startup Program
benefit: 50% off the entire JetBrains suite for up to five years, up to 10 IDE licenses, 10 team and learning tools, and 10 JetBrains AI subscriptions. Partner route starts with 6 months free.
eligibility: Startups established within the last five years. Commercial licenses only. Once per organization.

name: Sentry for Startups
benefit: Up to $5,000 in credits expiring after 12 months, plus priority support

name: Datadog for Startups
benefit: A year of Datadog, up to $100k in credits

name: New Relic for Startups
benefit: Free platform access, including every AI feature

name: Algolia Startup Program

name: Clerk for Startups
benefit: Clerk Pro features at a discount
eligibility: Eligible up to 1 year after launch with up to $5 million in venture funding

name: Retool for Startups
benefit: 100% off coupon for one year, value up to $60k, on monthly Team or Business, then 25% off the next year

name: CodeRabbit Startup Program

name: SuprSend for Startups
benefit: 3 months free after signup, then 50% off for another 3 months on Essentials and Business

name: Convex for Startups
benefit: Up to 1 year free of Convex Professional, including no seat fees and 30% off usage-based fees up to $30k

name: Snowflake for Startups
benefit: Free usage on the first contract

name: Aiven for Startups

name: Airtable for Startups

name: Whimsical Startup Program

name: Brex for Startups
